Navigation index only. The active Typst thesis owns the wording and
interpretation of the research questions.

## Active Research Questions

- **RQ1 — Objective and endpoint contract:**
  [`01-introduction.typ` → Research Questions](../../typst/thesis/sections/01-introduction.typ),
  with the objective defined in
  [`03-02-target-task-and-rri-labels.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/03-oracle-and-data-generation/03-02-target-task-and-rri-labels.typ).
- **RQ2 — Offline finite-candidate planning:**
  [`01-introduction.typ` → Research Questions](../../typst/thesis/sections/01-introduction.typ),
  with bounded lookahead and value learning in
  [`04-05-finite-candidate-value-model.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/04-method/04-05-finite-candidate-value-model.typ)
  and
  [`05-02-learning-objective-and-replay-evidence.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/05-experimental-design/05-02-learning-objective-and-replay-evidence.typ).
- **RQ3 — Actor-visible representation:**
  [`01-introduction.typ` → Research Questions](../../typst/thesis/sections/01-introduction.typ),
  with the visibility and representation contracts in
  [`03-01-state-and-visibility.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/03-oracle-and-data-generation/03-01-state-and-visibility.typ),
  [`04-01-scene-representation-requirements.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/04-method/04-01-scene-representation-requirements.typ), and
  [`04-02-descriptor-and-encoding-plan.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/04-method/04-02-descriptor-and-encoding-plan.typ).
- **RQ4 — Support and scale:**
  [`01-introduction.typ` → Research Questions](../../typst/thesis/sections/01-introduction.typ),
  with replay support and evidence scope in
  [`03-03-replay-stores-and-diagnostics.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/03-oracle-and-data-generation/03-03-replay-stores-and-diagnostics.typ)

  [`06-results.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/06-results.typ).

## Deferred Extensions

Online discrete value learning, continuous actions, simulator integration, and
real-device deployment are not additional active research questions. Their
development-profile scope is recorded in
[`06-draft-open-work.typ` → Rejected Scope](../../typst/thesis/sections/06-draft-open-work.typ),
with scientific limitations in
[`07-discussion.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/07-discussion.typ)
and the evaluated boundary in
[`08-conclusion.typ`](../../typst/thesis/sections/08-conclusion.typ).
